data.one_liner: A Dart utility package for generating random words, names, usernames, and passwords.
data.what_it_does: Generates random nouns, verbs, names, usernames, and email addresses with various filtering and case-formatting options. It also provides robust password generation, passphrase creation, PIN generation, and strength validation.
use_when: You need placeholder text, random words, or fake user identities for prototyping.
Your application requires random password generation and strength validation.
You need deterministic random generation using seeds for testing.
avoid_when: You require complex linguistic morphology beyond simple noun/verb generation and syllable counting.
You need cryptographic key generation rather than human-readable passwords or passphrases.
strengths: Comprehensive feature set covering both word generation and password security checks.
Flexible filtering options for words (by length, starting/ending characters, containment).
Supports seeded random generation for reproducible testing.
weaknesses: Password strength scores and entropy labels are heuristic-based estimates rather than security guarantees.
Limited to English word lists and rules.
